title: Marketing & Partnerships Lead
html:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

We're looking for a Marketer with experience in building a strong brand image and securing strategic partnerships. As a B2B startup in our early stages, we want someone who can help convey our vision to the world.

This position will be the first Marketing hire in Ailytics, being at the forefront of branding initiatives and business expansion to support our Business Development team.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You'll have a front row seat and a direct impact on the continued growth of Ailytics. You'll be working closely with our CEO and other members of our Business Development team to drive sales growth through marketing efforts.
  • Identify, negotiate, and secure opportunities and potential leads to accelerate business growth.
  • Coordinate and represent Ailytics at key events and engagements such as expos.
  • Manage company socials such as our website and social media pages, maintaining a consistent brand voice and ensuring that future content is aligned accordingly.
  • Create content with two main focus pillars; marketing Ailytics' tech offerings for B2B clients, and marketing Ailytics as a top employment destination.
  • Design and manage marketing collaterals, including marketing decks, banners, flyers, etc.
  • Develop video content for general marketing purposes; this may or may not include AI content creation at times.
  • Work with the Talent & Branding team for LinkedIn communications, which may include company announcements, event recaps, content pieces, and employee features.

Our Ideal Requirements

  • Prior experience in developing and executing strategic partnerships and branding initiatives, ideally in a B2B environment.
  • Strong commercial mindset; understanding the business and the impact of branding.
  • Experience with content creation and management of social media channels. Experience with website management would be a plus.
  • Comfort working with limited resources and direction. This will be a true startup experience with less tools, less gameplans, but more freedom.
  • Strong proficiency with AI tools for content creation, distribution, and SEO optimisation; able to stay current with rapidly evolving tools and workflows.
  • A strong sense of brand voice, messaging, and positioning.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Why Work At Ailytics?

  • This is an opportunity to create lasting impact and explore the intersection of AI and safety.
  • We're a start-up that's still in its early stages. If you're looking for an environment where you can really make an impact, this is it.
  • We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.
